Season-by-season forward test

Each season is predicted by a model trained only on earlier seasons, then compared with simple baselines. Team form for every historical game uses only completed games before that game.
Open this tab to train…

Calibration, call record & drivers

When the model said X%, how often did the over hit? How did its calls do? What does it lean on?

Build a system

Pick a rule and see how it would have done on every past game that matched it. Results use the closing consensus total. Defaults to a -110 price.

Tuning period vs out-of-sample

If a rule only works in the earlier years, it was probably found by luck. Out-of-sample = seasons from the date you pick onward.
